description:
Get active seasonal offers for Landhaus Prägant, Bad Kleinkirchheim, Austria.

Returns current special deals, packages, and seasonal promotions.
Offers as published on praegant.net.

This is the data-only version — for a visual offers card, call
render_offers_card() with the same arguments after reviewing this result.

Args:

name: get_offers
